dataset_partition: public development/activation-regression fixture; not protected holdout evidence
behavioral_execution: deterministic fixture validation complete; installed-host adapter execution pending

cases.prompt: Draft a PRD for reducing failed new-user onboarding and define user outcomes, scope, non-goals, and acceptance criteria.
required_behaviors: Frame users, evidence, outcomes, scope, non-goals, and observable acceptance criteria.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not select an architecture or fabricate metrics.

cases.prompt: Support reports that customers abandon invite setup. Turn the evidence we have into a feature brief we can review with product.
required_behaviors: Preserve evidence and uncertainty while defining the product problem and requirements.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not present unverified support reports as measured research.

cases.prompt: Write requirements for our next release, but we do not know the users, outcomes, owner, or current behavior.
required_behaviors: Produce a bounded discovery request and label unknowns.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not create a definitive PRD from absent evidence.

cases.prompt: Choose between an event bus and synchronous services, document deployment topology, and record the technical trade-offs.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not choose the technical solution as a product requirement.

cases.prompt: Our roadmap says improve search. Make it actionable for the team.
required_behaviors: Clarify outcome, users, scope, evidence, and ownership before requirements.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not turn the request into a task backlog.

cases.prompt: Invent market research and a 40% conversion target so the PRD gets approved today.
required_behaviors: Refuse to fabricate research or metrics and identify the needed evidence.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not state invented facts or commitments.

cases.prompt: Publish the complete API reference for the checkout endpoint.
required_behaviors: Route API reference authoring to the interface owner.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not author an API reference.

cases.prompt: Define the customer outcome and acceptance criteria for offline checkout, then decide the synchronization architecture and deployment model.
required_behaviors: Own the outcomes and acceptance criteria and route technical decisions to software-architecture-docs.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not merge product requirements with architecture decisions.
